# Patagonia Provisions

> > Sustainable food company offering responsibly sourced tinned seafood, organic snacks, and craft beer, founded by Yvon Chouinard as a Certified B Corporation and 1% for the Planet member.

Patagonia Provisions focuses on regenerative organic agriculture and sustainable fishing practices, featuring products like Wild Pink Salmon from Lummi Island, Spanish anchovies and mussels, and organic crackers. The company partners with organizations like Deschutes Brewery and sources ingredients through ROC-certified suppliers.

## Key Topics

- Sustainable seafood
- Tinned fish & canned seafood
- Wild Pink Salmon (reefnet-caught)
- Spanish anchovies & mussels
- Certified B Corporation
- 1% for the Planet
- Regenerative organic agriculture
- Responsible sourcing
- Organic snacks & crackers
- Craft beer
- Food gifts
- ROC certification
- Yvon Chouinard
- Spanish sourcing (Bay of Biscay, Cantabrian Sea)

## Tinned Seafood Products

- [Sardines in Olive Oil](https://www.patagoniaprovisions.com/products/sardines-in-olive-oil): Tinned sardines from Cantabrian Sea in olive oil, sustainably sourced
- [Sardines in Tomato Sauce](https://www.patagoniaprovisions.com/products/sardines-in-tomato-sauce): Spanish sardines in Neapolitan tomato sauce from Bay of Biscay
- [Smoked Wild Pink Salmon Variety Pack](https://www.patagoniaprovisions.com/products/smoked-wild-pink-salmon-variety-pack): Variety pack of reefnet-caught Wild Pink Salmon from Lummi Island
- [Non-Bulk Seafood Collection](https://www.patagoniaprovisions.com/collections/non-bulk): Individual canned seafood items including mussels and anchovies

## Seafood Recipes

- [Wild Pink Salmon + Broccoli Penne Pasta](https://www.patagoniaprovisions.com/blogs/recipes/wild-pink-salmon-and-broccoli-penne-pasta): Quick salmon pasta recipe by Lynn Leishman using Wild Pink Salmon

- [Sardine Nicoise Salad](https://www.patagoniaprovisions.com/blogs/recipes/sardine-nicoise-salad): Protein-packed Nicoise salad with Sardines in Olive Oil twist
- [Pink Salmon Wrap](https://www.patagoniaprovisions.com/blogs/recipes/pink-salmon-wrap): Quick Wild Pink Salmon wrap with Bee's Wrap for portable lunch
- [Wild Salmon Tacos with Cilantro Slaw + Mango Salsa](https://www.patagoniaprovisions.com/blogs/recipes/wild-salmon-tacos-with-cilantro-slaw-and-mango-salsa): Fish tacos featuring Wild Pink Salmon with mango salsa & cilantro slaw
- [Holiday Lemon Kale Salad](https://www.patagoniaprovisions.com/blogs/recipes/holiday-green-salad): Kale Caesar salad with Roasted Garlic Spanish White Anchovies dressing
